text: A muscular male with a lean, athletic build. Skin tone is light tan. Hair: long blonde, braided down back. Face: angular jawline, intense gaze, slight stubble. Costume: fur-trimmed leather loincloth, brown belt with ornate buckle, black boots. Wears a circular pendant necklace and an earring. Pose: crouched low, knees bent, body tensed forward as if preparing to strike or run. Sword sheathed at hip. Appears ready for action.
